name: touchdesigner-mcp-setdesign
description: Architecture preview: operator catalog, live maps, explainable roles, native inspector and private memory
long_description:
# TouchDesigner MCP — Architecture Preview

An MIT-licensed fork of 8beeeaaat/touchdesigner-mcp, maintained by Sarvesh Chidambaram. Adds build-aware operator knowledge, bounded live graph maps, explainable classification, a native inspector, and local project/personal memory. Working-copy encapsulation is guarded and experimental; full native restructuring acceptance is not certified in this preview. All 16 prior tools remain available alongside seven architecture tools.

This launcher installs the exact fork release from its GitHub tarball. Install the matching native architecture bundle separately. The execution bridge has full access to the TouchDesigner process and should remain on loopback.

tools.name: describe_td_tools
tools.description: Generate filesystem manifests of TouchDesigner tools with detailLevel/responseFormat/filter options for code execution environments

tools.name: create_td_node
tools.description: Create new nodes in TouchDesigner with specified family and parameters

tools.name: delete_td_node
tools.description: Delete existing nodes from TouchDesigner by path

tools.name: execute_python_script
tools.description: Execute Python scripts directly in TouchDesigner environment with full API access

tools.name: exec_node_method
tools.description: Execute methods on TouchDesigner nodes (cook, pulse, reset, etc.)

tools.name: get_td_info
tools.description: Get TouchDesigner server information and connection status

tools.name: get_td_module_help
tools.description: Get Python help() documentation for TouchDesigner modules and classes

tools.name: get_td_class_details
tools.description: Get detailed documentation for TouchDesigner Python classes

tools.name: get_td_classes
tools.description: List available TouchDesigner Python classes and modules

tools.name: get_td_node_errors
tools.description: Check for errors on a specified node and its children

tools.name: get_td_node_parameters
tools.description: Retrieve parameters and current values for TouchDesigner nodes

tools.name: get_td_nodes
tools.description: List nodes in TouchDesigner with filtering options

tools.name: get_top_image
tools.description: Capture the current output of a TOP node as a JPEG image, optionally downscaled to a maximum size

tools.name: update_td_node_parameters
tools.description: Update parameter values for TouchDesigner nodes

tools.name: get_td_network_snapshot
tools.description: Bounded read-only network structure and diagnostics snapshot

tools.name: layout_td_network
tools.description: Preview-first direct-child coordinate layout; applies only when explicitly requested

tools.name: get_td_operator_catalog
tools.description: Discover build-specific registered operators, support evidence and bounded reference links.

tools.name: map_td_project
tools.description: Refresh, watch, inspect or diff a bounded project graph with explicit freshness.

tools.name: classify_td_network
tools.description: Explain operator roles and propose deterministic pinned layouts without moving nodes.

tools.name: plan_td_refactor
tools.description: Preview grouping siblings with complete dependency checks and explicit blockers.

tools.name: stage_td_refactor
tools.description: Apply a reviewed refactor plan or recover its durable transaction status.

tools.name: get_td_memory
tools.description: Read bounded architecture notes with provenance and freshness.

tools.name: record_td_memory
tools.description: Record, correct, retire or explicitly promote a project architecture note.

prompts.name: Search node
prompts.description: Find TouchDesigner nodes by various criteria
prompts.text: Search for TouchDesigner nodes using filters like name, family type, or parent path.

prompts.name: Check node errors
prompts.description: Analyze and diagnose TouchDesigner node errors
prompts.text: Analyze the current TouchDesigner project for node errors and provide debugging suggestions.

prompts.name: Node connection
prompts.description: Guide for connecting TouchDesigner nodes properly
prompts.text: Provide guidance on how to properly connect TouchDesigner nodes for optimal data flow.
